evidence: Carries the Validation label and alters block file pruning and flush handling in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a disk space leak where block files scheduled for pruning are never unlinked if a flush fails before writing the block index. The issue is cleanly deferrable because leaked files are already recovered on node restart via ScanAndUnlinkAlreadyPrunedFiles.
